opportunities.name: Trip planning: flight + hotel + activity, then note summary
opportunities.description: For a destination and date range, search Google Flights from Paris, search Booking.com stays, search a Viator activity, then record the flight price, hotel and activity in Notes.
steps: Open Google Flights, set origin Paris, enter destination and select departure/return dates, click Done and Search
Note the cheapest flight airline and price
Open Booking.com, enter destination, pick the suggestion, select check-in/check-out dates, click Search
Open the top hotel result and note its name and price
Open Viator, search for the activity query, skip dates, open the top tour and note its title and price
Open Notes and add a line 'Trip <dest> <dates>: flight <airline price>, hotel <name price>, <activity title price>' and press Enter

instances.values: Rome, Dec 3-7 2026, 'Colosseum tour Rome'; flight easyJet 89, hotel Room Roma Nazionale 452, tour 54.00
Barcelona, Jan 20-24 2027, 'Sagrada Familia tour Barcelona'; flight Vueling EUR113, hotel IBIS BUDGET BARCELONA CENTER EUR543, tour EUR54

opportunities.name: Compare two PyPI packages (version, date, stars, license) and note
opportunities.description: For a pair of Python packages, search each on PyPI, open its project page and its repository link, then write a comparison line to Notes.
steps: Click PyPI search box and type the package name, press Enter
Click the matching package in results
Read version, release date, and click the Source/Repository link to get stars and license
Repeat for the second package
Open Notes and type 'pkgA ver date stars license vs pkgB ...' and press Enter

opportunities.name: Browser support lookup (caniuse + MDN) and reply by email
opportunities.description: For a CSS/web feature, check caniuse support, find the MDN docs page, and draft an email to a person with the supported version and docs link.
steps: Search the feature on caniuse and read the browser support
Open MDN, click site Search, type the feature, press Enter
Open the matching MDN page for the docs URL
Open mail compose, enter recipient, subject 'Re: <feature> in <browser>', and body with version and docs link
Click Discard/Send

opportunities.name: PyPI package search to project page
opportunities.description: Search a package name on PyPI and open its project page, optionally following the source link.
steps: Click search box
Type package name and press Enter
Click the top matching result
Click Source/Repository link
